archetypes.name: migration-equivalence
archetypes.rationale: Large shell-to-Python port needs behavior parity scrutiny.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the new Python decompose and scout implementations against the documented shell contracts. Focus on preserved KVs, sentinels, output files, retry seams, and fail-open or fail-closed behavior. Call out any behavior drift that would break existing orchestration or harness assumptions Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: shell-callsite
archetypes.rationale: Many shell callsites now invoke Python verbs directly.
archetypes.prompt_body: Inspect the edited shell callsites for quoting, Bash 3.2 portability, quiet-stream behavior, and correct argv construction. Pay special attention to dynamic scout invocation, scope-anchor handoff, and findings-classification header generation Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: docs-topology
archetypes.rationale: The migration updates topology, docs, rules, and stale-reference manifests together.
archetypes.prompt_body: Check that docs, topology rows, rule frontmatter, migrated-scripts entries, and Makefile targets consistently describe the new Python surface. Look for stale retired script names outside intentional Makefile target names and the migrated-scripts manifest Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
